summary.intent: Diagnose and fix 3 SDK E2E test failures blocking the phase-71 merge gate, distinguishing real regressions from pre-existing/environmental failures.
summary.outcome: Identified tee-republish failures as environmental (no TEE simulator on :3002) and rotation-crash-safety as a real phase-71 regression in the new D-05 equivocation guard; fixed it, added a companion unit test, validated with 6/6 e2e passes and 110 passing ipns unit tests, and committed the fix.

repo: commitlint's subject-no-parens rule is enforced only on the PR title via pr-title.yml, not on individual commits in CI — no need to reword 60 historical commit subjects containing parens.

sdk-e2e's tee-republish tests require a TEE worker/simulator on :3002 which is not part of standard sdk-e2e prereqs; failures there log 'TEE worker unavailable — expected without a simulator' and are environmental, not regressions.

To capture the exact reason for a handled 4xx (API doesn't log it), temporarily instrument packages/api-client/src/instance.ts's customInstance with a response interceptor, rebuild the client chain, repro, then revert — this is the established recipe for this repo.

code.finding: D-05 same-seq CID-equivocation guard throws 400 whenever embeddedSeq === dbSeq && metadataCid !== existing.latestCid, but this also fires for a legitimate forward-CAS attempt that lost a race (writer intended embeddedSeq = its_view+1 with expectedSequenceNumber = its_view, but a concurrent writer advanced dbSeq first). Fixed by falling through to the CAS UPDATE (→ 409) when expectedSequenceNumber === embeddedSeq - 1, preserving equivocation protection for the true idempotent-republish case (no expectedSequenceNumber sent).
CAS UPDATE mechanism returns 409 when expected (expectedSequenceNumber) doesn't match the DB sequence — this is the path the D-05 guard was incorrectly short-circuiting before it could run.

Existing D-05 equivocation unit test sends no expectedSequenceNumber, so it correctly remains a 400 after the fix (unchanged); new companion test added just before the idempotent-republish test to lock in the forward-CAS-race case (same-seq, different CID, expectedSequenceNumber === embeddedSeq-1) as a 409.

Concurrent-add test deliberately triggers a concurrent republish expecting a 409 CAS-merge ('CAS-409 is merged internally'); the 71-02 rename of this test was pure rename with no logic change, so it wasn't the source of the regression.

workflow: When an E2E gate fails, classify each failure by checking whether the touched file/logic was changed in the current phase's commits vs origin/main before assuming a regression.
For timing-sensitive concurrent tests, re-run the suite multiple times to distinguish deterministic regressions from flakes before investing in a fix.

friction: sdk-e2e gate reported 3 failures with no direct indication of which were pre-existing vs new, requiring manual git-blame-style investigation per failure.
API doesn't log handled 4xx responses, requiring a temporary interceptor instrumentation + client rebuild just to see the actual error body/reason.
